title: Curriculum context from real sources only
statement: Give a judge only curriculum data from a real source, and where the source has nothing, leave the field empty rather than have a model fill it.
detail: On an unmerged branch that widens the AP judge's curriculum context, the merged data is described as a pure data combination with no model-generated content (commit fb17482 in `icloud-work/inceptbench`), and the context block as real framework or curriculum-repository content only, with no model-generated scaffolding (commit 082d3a3 in `icloud-work/inceptbench`). Where the published framework has no boundaries or misconceptions for a course, the branch leaves them out rather than fabricate them. A real source is the published framework or the curriculum's own authored records.
against: It exists only on that unmerged branch; versions 2.6.3 and 2.6.6 still send the judge a flat seven-field record (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/src/inceptbench/evaluators/base.py`, L796-817).

evidence.quote: (CB CED has no published boundaries/misconceptions for APEURO; we don't fabricate them)
